senses.gloss: m. (dial. for בַּרְקָא, v. ברק a. deriv.; cmp. בָּאגָא a. בִּקְעָא) sparkling, effervescent; white-shining.
units: Ab. Zar. 30ᵃ מתוק חמר ב׳ Ar. (ed. מי ב׳) by ‘sweet wine’ we understand effervescent wine (liquid) (mulsum vinum or mulsa aqua, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Vinum).—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98a:14">Snh. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>סוסיא ב׳</he> quot. in Rashi to Ab. Zar. l. c., Ar. s. v. <cite ref="B01317"><he>ברקא</he></cite> (ed. <cite ref="B01317"><he>ברקא</he></cite>) a white-shining horse. [Deriv. fr. Pers. bârah is refuted by <cite ref="B01317"><he>ברקא</he></cite> being used as an equivalent of our w.; v. also Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, 284ᵃ.]
